setup.en: Opus 5.5 (effort medium) plans, codes, tests and iterates by itself.
setup.zh: Opus 5.5（effort medium）自己规划、写码、测试、迭代。

notes.en: Clean neon look, crisp shake and score pop-ups; two text overlaps (clear bonus, boss label under HUD).
notes.zh: 等宽霓虹风，干净但偏朴素；震屏和飘字利落，有两处文字重叠。

label.zh: Opus 写 spec + DeepSeek 写码

setup.en: Opus 5.5 writes a 271-line spec only. DeepSeek (deepseek-flash, via DeepSeek Harness) implements it in one run. Opus never reviews.
setup.zh: Opus 5.5 只写 271 行 spec，DeepSeek（deepseek-flash，经 DeepSeek Harness）一次跑完实现，Opus 不 review。

notes.en: Synthwave grid, best-polished panels, particles and boss bar; richest feedback. Boss fight on the hard side.
notes.zh: 合成波网格，面板、粒子、血条打磨最细，反馈最饱满；boss 战偏难。

setup.en: Same as A, with effort raised to high.
setup.zh: 和 A 组相同，effort 调到 high。

notes.en: Clean sans-serif look, a boss with expressions that gets angry, combo pitch steps; smooth pacing, almost no flaws. Shortest code.
notes.zh: 无衬线清爽风格，boss 有表情会暴怒，连击音阶上升；节奏顺畅几乎无瑕疵，代码最精简。

label.zh: Opus 写 spec + Kimi 写码

setup.en: The exact spec from group B, handed to Kimi k3.1-pro (Kimi Code CLI). Only the coder changes. Cost includes the reused Opus spec ($0.97) plus Kimi ($0.81).
setup.zh: 直接用 B 组那份 spec，交给 Kimi k3.1-pro（Kimi Code CLI），只换写码模型。成本含复用的 Opus spec（$0.97）和 Kimi（$0.81）。

notes.en: Same level data as B (same spec). Unified synthwave look, laser and 3-phase boss; leftover balls and capsules freeze on transition screens.
notes.zh: 和 B 组同一套关卡数据（同一份 spec）。合成波风格统一，有激光和三阶段 boss；过场画面残留冻结的球和道具。

setup.en: Kimi k3.1-pro gets only the requirement and works like group A.
setup.zh: Kimi k3.1-pro 只拿到需求原文，和 A 组一样独立完成。

notes.en: Strongest UI design (sci-fi panels, buttons, sector labels), but quiet audio, only 2 power-ups, and a real bug: the ball can pass straight through the moving boss.
notes.zh: UI 设计感最强（科幻面板、按钮、扇区标签），但音效偏轻、只有 2 种道具，且有真实 bug：球会直接穿过移动中的 boss。

original.en: Reddit original (5-level pixel platformer): Opus alone 16 min / $2.52 / 25 of 25; Opus + local Qwen 42 min / $0.62 / 24 of 25.
original.zh: Reddit 原帖（5 关像素平台跳跃）：Opus 单干 16 分钟 / $2.52 / 25/25；Opus + 本地 Qwen 42 分钟 / $0.62 / 24/25。

grading.en: All five builds were renamed P–T at random and graded by one fresh agent with one shared headless-Chrome harness and one subjective scale. Mapping: P=A, Q=D, R=B, S=C, T=E.
grading.zh: 五份游戏随机改名为 P–T，由同一个全新代理用同一套 headless Chrome 脚本和同一把主观尺子打分。对应关系：P=A，Q=D，R=B，S=C，T=E。
